supplementary_methods.paraphrase: THP1-Cas13d clones selected after single-cell sorting; RPMI plus 10% FBS; lentiviral guide transduction; puromycin selection at least five days; single-cell-screen MOI below 0.1; doxycycline induction; cells maintained with doxycycline, blasticidin and puromycin and passaged every 2-3 days.

reporting_summary.paraphrase: The THP1 CaRPool-seq replicated single/double perturbations with alternate guides. GFI1 g2 was removed after disagreement with g1. Hashing labels individual samples and identifies singlets. Separate FACS experiments had independent replication.
